draft.name: Harbour Bard
draft.description: Brass lute strings resonate, Harbour Bard strumming by the docks. His rose pink cloak billows, as crimson sails unfurl. In between verses, he feeds seagulls bits of his lunch, bread crumbs dyed pink.
